verdict.line: You lose if you auto-trade or all-in while Jax's E (Counter Strike) is up; you win if you bait it on cooldown and punish with Q-E-R combos from level 6 on.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire combo (Q's empowered auto chained into E's knockup) is attack-based, and Jax's E (Counter Strike, cooldown 18/16/14/12/10s) dodges all incoming basic attacks before stunning everything around him. Walking an all-in into an active Counter Strike gets your autos voided and you eat the stun instead, which is why Jax holds lane and solo-kill advantage despite the overall numbers being close. Your W (Tactical Sweep) is a cast spell, not a basic attack, so it still connects through that dodge window — that's the entire reason to poke with it instead of trading autos.

theirWindow.when: His E is up and you commit
theirWindow.what: If you walk Q's empowered auto or an E (Hookshot) knockup into an active Counter Strike, your attacks are dodged and he stuns + damages you right back. Back off and poke with W instead.

yourWindow.when: He's just used or baited out his E
yourWindow.what: Counter Strike has no dodge or stun available for 10-18s depending on rank. This is your window for the real combo: Q auto, E (Hookshot) knockup, and R (The Hextech Ultimatum) once you have it to lock him in.

start.why: The 49% win rate pick over 2,008 games and 55.6% pick rate here; the extra sustain and damage matter because you're not forcing early trades, you're surviving them while you wait out his E.

boots.why: 70% pick rate and the higher win rate of the two boot options (49.3% over 2,219 games); flat physical damage reduction directly counters Jax's R (Relentless Assault) stacking attack speed and his empowered Q/W autos.

core.why: Highest win-rate core path (57.2% over 685 games); gives you the stats to actually win extended duels once his R is active.
Sustain through poke exchanges and wave clear so you're never forced to fight before you want to.
Completes the 43.6%-pick, 57.2%-win core; the damage mitigation bridges you through his empowered Q/W hits between your own cooldowns.

situational.when: you're getting burst down in all-in windows and need to survive to use your knockup
you're ahead and want to snowball by shortening your Q and E cooldowns to punish his E downtime faster
the enemy jungler or mid is heavy magic damage or hard CC and Jax alone isn't the main threat
you need the early sustain and wave clear before Ravenous Hydra completes

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the patient poke-and-farm pattern this matchup demands; every proc stacks health so you're tankier for the 6+ all-in windows instead of forcing early fights you don't need.

summoners.why: The most-picked combo (54%) and it fits the plan directly: Ignite closes out the kill the moment you catch Jax with his E down, and Flash lets you disengage safely if you misjudge his Counter Strike timing.

playing.title: Bait Counter Strike before committing
playing.detail: Never open your all-in combo while Jax's E is up — it dodges all your basic attacks and stuns you on activation. Wait for it on a minion, ward, or bad read.

playing.title: Poke with W, not autos
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep is a cast spell, so it lands through an active Counter Strike when your autos wouldn't. Use the outer-cone slow and healing to chip him down while you farm, exactly as the matchup data suggests.

playing.title: Use R to trap him at level 6+
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors Jax to the fight area so his Leap Strike (cooldown 17/14/11/8/5s) can't disengage once you're in range. Before level 6 he can always jump away from a losing trade — this is why your real power spike starts here.

playing.title: Disengage once his R is ramped
playing.detail: Relentless Assault has no cooldown and ramps attack speed with every hit, dealing bonus damage every third strike. Don't stand in extended autoattack exchanges once it's visibly stacked.

playing.title: Watch his Empower cooldown
playing.detail: W (Empower) is only 7/6/5/4/3s, so a hard-hitting auto or Leap Strike is available almost every exchange. Don't trade your own auto into a visibly empowered hit.

playing.title: Finish Hydra and Death's Dance before forcing late fights
playing.detail: Jax's passive (Equipment Mastery) gives him bonus health off his own AD/AP items, so he gets harder to burst down as the game goes. Your sustained damage and healing from a completed core keep you relevant into the 14+ range where he naturally pulls ahead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability mechanics are pulled directly from the game files. The tactical reading of how those two interact — the Counter Strike bait pattern, the R timing window — is my own analysis layered on top of that data.
